proposals.evidence: Turner records Kalasha hast, Western Pahari/Punjabi hatth and Nepali/Marathi hāt hand. These bare survey hand words answer the palm prompt by narrowing hand to its palm; no unexpressed tala component is added.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Bengali dor/duār, Nepali duwār and Kotgarhi dwār door under *duvāra. Hajong dur, Kullui dvār and Dang ḍuār fit these eastern/Pahari regional forms, with the Dang retroflex spelling retained as a phonetic qualification. The short northwestern dar forms subject to Persian influence are excluded.
